changes.summary: PENNY_MTP_POLICY: one setting selects the native-MTP width policy file and the launch width that carries it. tiered (unchanged public default: block 8 at one running request, block 4 at two or more), adaptive (the exact v3.0.2 policy, byte-for-byte, with its 40/80-batch hold and backoff), fixed-w4 (block 4 at every concurrency). The hard-coded policy checksum gate is replaced by hashing the selected file into the NIXL namespace. DFlash2 and 27B routes read nothing from it.

Derive post-verify lengths for the DFlash2 mamba checkpoint-grid crossing so accepted blocks are tracked instead of leaving an unwritten checkpoint to be registered or promoted. Both DFlash profiles were affected (Flash-Next extra_buffer/grid 64, 27B extra_buffer_lazy/interval 256). Also labels the DFlash2 integration experimental / alpha on both profiles at every user-facing surface.

changes.summary: With --sleep-on-idle and language-only EPD separation, skip the scheduler idle sleep while mm_receiver has requests waiting for encoder embeddings; those arrive on a socket the sleeper's poll does not watch, so they waited for the 1-second poll timeout.
